title: Prestige & Willshaw (1975), Willshaw & von der Malsburg (1976) & Brown et al. (2000) Retinotectal Chemoaffinity & Synaptic Competition: Counter-Gradient EphA/Ephrin-A Topographic Inversion, Group II Compression/Expansion & Isl2-EphA3 Knock-In Map Duplication

primary_papers.citation: Prestige MC, Willshaw DJ (1975) On a role for competition in the formation of patterned neural connexions. Proc. R. Soc. Lond. B 190(1098):77-98

Brown A, Yates PA, Burrola P, Ortuno D, Vaidya A, Jessell TM, Pfaff SL, O'Leary DDM, Lemke G (2000) Topographic mapping from the retina to the midbrain is controlled by relative but not absolute levels of EphA receptor signaling. Cell 102(1):77-88
Willshaw DJ, von der Malsburg C (1976) How patterned neural connections can be set up by self-organization. Proc. R. Soc. Lond. B 194(1117):431-445
Koulakov AA, Tsigankov DN (2004) A stochastic model for retinocollicular map development. BMC Neuroscience 5:30

governing_equations.retinal_epha_gradient: R_A(x_i) = R_0 * exp(alpha * x_i) + Delta_R_EphA3 * I(i in Isl2+)
governing_equations.reciprocal_equilibrium_locus: R_A(x) * L_A(y^*(x)) = gamma_0 = R_0 * L_0 * exp(alpha)  ==>  y_WT^*(x) = 1 - x
governing_equations.isl2_epha3_anterior_shift: y_KI^*(x) = 1 - (1 / alpha) * ln(exp(alpha * x) + Delta_R_EphA3 / R_0) < 1 - x
governing_equations.group_ii_synaptic_weight_ode: dW_ij/dt = W_ij * [ -E_chem(x_i, y_j) + kappa_coop * (K_ret * W * K_tec)_ij - mu_ret * (sum_k W_ik - 1) - mu_tec * (sum_m W_mj - N_ret / N_tec_active) ]
governing_equations.half_tectum_compression_law: y_comp^*(x) = 0.5 * (1 - x) for x in [0, 1] onto rostral half-tectum y in [0, 0.5] (slope = -0.50)
governing_equations.half_retina_expansion_law: y_exp^*(x) = 1 - 2 * x for nasal half-retina x in [0, 0.5] onto full tectum y in [0, 1] (slope = -2.00)

experimental_regimes.description: Wild-type retinotectal projection (Delta_R_EphA3 = 0, intact retina x in [0,1], intact tectum y in [0,1]): nasal RGCs (low EphA) project to posterior/caudal tectum (high ephrin-A) and temporal RGCs (high EphA) project to anterior/rostral tectum (low ephrin-A), forming a single continuous inverted map y*(x) = 1 - x

Brown et al. (2000) Isl2-EphA3/+ heterozygous knock-in (Delta_R_EphA3 = 0.90 on 50% Isl2+ RGCs): Isl2+ RGCs shift rostrally while Isl2- WT RGCs shift caudally via Group II synaptic competition, producing a partially bifurcated map that converges near the rostral pole

Brown et al. (2000) Isl2-EphA3/EphA3 homozygous knock-in (Delta_R_EphA3 = 1.80 on 50% Isl2+ RGCs): relative EphA signaling and Group II competition bifurcate the projection into two complete, non-overlapping topographic maps (Isl2+ in rostral half y in [0, 0.5], Isl2- WT displaced into caudal half y in [0.5, 1.0])

Prestige & Willshaw (1975) caudal half-tectum ablation (y in [0, 0.5] remaining): Group II relative competition compresses the entire retinal axis x in [0, 1] linearly onto the rostral half-tectum y*(x) = 0.5*(1 - x) with slope -0.50

Prestige & Willshaw (1975) temporal half-retina ablation (nasal half-retina x in [0, 0.5] remaining): Group II competition for vacant rostral tectal sites expands the nasal half-retina across the entire tectum y*(x) = 1 - 2*x with slope -2.00
Ephrin-A2/A5 double knockout ablation control (beta = 0, flat tectal ligand L_A(y) = L_0): loss of graded ephrin-A positional cues abolishes retinotectal topographic polarity (|r| < 0.15)

specimen_provenance.species: Danio rerio (72 hpf zebrafish larval retina)
